analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (102,470 KRW) vs SMA5 (109,831 KRW) / SMA20 (109,728 KRW) / SMA50 (104,747 KRW): Below short-term/mid-term trends, entering resistance zone for mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 (139,757 KRW) / SMA200 (110,719 KRW): Below long-term/very long-term trends, in a bearish zone.
· 52-week position (31.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.9 → 43.1): Entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (702.5844 → -356.1192): Worsening, strengthening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 99,778 KRW): Approaching lower band, band width expanded to 18.14%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (98,695 KRW): Based on 20-day low, key defense line on decline.
· Swing resistance (115,010 KRW): Based on 5-day high, signal of upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Attempting recovery by making higher lows.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.13x): Normal level, moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Potential for buy consideration due to RSI entering oversold and Higher Low pattern formation, but maintaining wait-and-see due to continued lack of trend indicated by ADX.
